desc: Built with superb attention to detail one at a time by skilled technicians, the 2K11 Comp delivers a significant reduction in felt recoil. This new integrated compensator is an elegant solution that is machined seamlessly into the slide and barrel. This latest introduction to the 2K11 family anchors a fully capable high capacity 1911 double stack that creates the most complete shooting experience available in the 2K11 line. Available with Custom MJD grip. Pro length models ship with Checkmate Ultra High-Capacity Magazines. This new 2K11 is the flattest shooting, most accurate and highest performance competitive handgun Kimber has ever built.
